recommendations:
TOP RESTAURANTS
1. Le Bernardin, Seafood, $120-$200 (INR 9000-15000), must-order Pan-Seared Scallops.
2. Carbone, Italian-American, $50-$100 (INR 3750-7500), must-order Lobster Fra Diavolo.
3. Peter Luger Steak House, Steakhouse, $60-$120 (INR 4500-9000), must-order Porterhouse Steak.
4. Di Fara Pizza, Pizzeria, $15-$30 (INR 1125-2250), must-order Classic Square Slice.
5. Momofuku Noodle Bar, Pan-Asian, $20-$40 (INR 1500-3000), must-order Pork Buns.

TOP ATTRACTIONS
1. Statue of Liberty, Iconic landmark and symbol of freedom, best time to go is early morning, entry fee $21.50 (INR 1625).
2. Central Park, Scenic green space in the middle of Manhattan, best time to go is afternoon, entry fee free.
3. Metropolitan Museum of Art, World-class art museum, best time to go is morning, entry fee $25 (INR 1875).
4. Brooklyn Bridge, Historic bridge with great city views, best time to go is sunset, entry fee free.
5. 9/11 Memorial & Museum, Tribute to the victims of the 9/11 attacks, best time to go is late afternoon, entry fee $24 (INR 1800).

HIDDEN GEMS
1. The Moravian Cemetery, a historic cemetery with interesting gravestones and a peaceful atmosphere.
2. The Little Red Lighthouse, a small lighthouse under the George Washington Bridge.
3. The New York Earth Room, an indoor sculpture featuring 280,000 pounds of dirt.

TRAVEL TIPS
1. Respect local customs by tipping at least 15% in restaurants and bars.
2. Use the subway or walk to get around the city, as traffic can be heavy.
3. Avoid common scams like paying for fake street performances or buying counterfeit goods.
4. Learn useful phrases like "excuse me" and "thank you" to interact with locals.
5. Be aware of your surroundings and keep an eye on your belongings, especially in crowded areas.

SHOPPING
1. SoHo, buy designer clothing and accessories, price range $50-$500 (INR 3750-37500).
2. Brooklyn Flea, buy vintage goods and street food, price range $10-$100 (INR 750-7500).
3. Chinatown, buy affordable souvenirs and try street food, price range $5-$50 (INR 375-3750).
